title.narrative: WGG- Building Inclusive Movements and Alliances in Bangladesh

description.narrative: It is a strategic platform for activists to participate in and learn about differing viewpoints, form creative alliances and highlight issues that are generally considered to be beyond the purview of women’s rights and gender justice.

sector.narrative: Support for feminist, women-led and women's rights organisations and movements, and institutions (governmental and non-govermental) at all levels to enhance their effectiveness, influence and substainability (activities and core-funding). These organisations exist to bring about transformative change for gender equality and/or the rights of women and girls in developing countries. Their activities include agenda-setting, advocacy, policy dialogue, capacity development, awareness raising and prevention, service provision, conflict-prevention and peacebuilding, research, organising, and alliance and network building

Experience Sharing Meeting with Different NGO that work with Young women group (Naripokkho, WGG partners in Bangladesh)

On 25 November, a sharing meeting took place with the participation of NGOs, networks, activists from Jamalpur and Sherpur, and Young Women Leaders (YWLs) . The total number of participants in the meeting was 28 individuals, representing organizations The meeting facilitated a fruitful participatory discussion centered on collaborative efforts to create a violence-free society and promote the well-being of young women. Participating organizations shared their valuable working experiences with the YWLs. They encouraged the YWLs to take initiatives for the elimination of all forms of violence and Sexual and Gender-Based Violence (SGBV), expressing a strong commitment to work together towards a shared goal. This meeting played a crucial role in helping YWLs connect with new networks, share knowledge, and exchange experiences, contributing to their growth and understanding of collaborative efforts in creating a safer community.

Capacity development programs

2 YWLs from Kaukhali and Kalshi have learned to design, write scripts, and moderate talk shows. They have organized and hosted 4 Talk shows broadcasting in different channels showcasing the potentiality and capabilities of YWLs gained through project activities.
Capacity development programs

4 CSOs/ collectives; Taranga Mohila kllyan Sangstha from Jamalpur, DDS Foundation from Pirojpur, Efforts for Rural Advancement (ERA) from Sunamganj and Social Association of rural Advancement (SARA) from Mymensingh district have increased capacities to conduct human rights advocacy towards developing inclusive and progressive norms on SGBV at national and community levels during 2022. The 4 collectives have attended WGG activities; project inception meetings, workshop on how to disseminate information, documentation, awareness raising by using different methods, community radio, social media, networking meeting with district level organizations, meeting with local media workers and bloggers along with Naripokkho’s activities; issue based weekly meeting, webinars etc through which the collectives have learned about project goal, objectives, activities and recent issues and connected with WGG activities throughout project period.
Capacity development programs

In 2023 YWLs of Kaukhali have become network members of the Bangladesh Mahila Parishad (BMP) and actively participate in their programs. The BMP is a well-known women's rights organization in Bangladesh. • 'Swnirvor Nari Kallyan Sangstha,' based in Sherpur Sadar, has attended duty bearer and networking meetings in Jamalpur district. There is mutual interest between the organizations to collaborate. 'Swnirvor Nari Kallyan Sangstha' focuses on women's rights, eliminating gender-based violence (SGBV), and creating safer spaces for women. During meetings, the organization expressed its commitment to working for young girls and women, alongside the YWLs.• Ganachetona, located in Deoyanganj, Jamalpur, is actively involved in working with youth, girls, and women. A representative from the organization attended duty bearer and networking meetings in Jamalpur. Ganachetona focuses on youth groups and women's rights and has shown interest and commitment to collaborating on eliminating SGBV.These collaborations reflect a shared commitment to promoting women's rights, creating safer spaces, and combating gender-based violence in the community.
